summary: Sullivan co-signed a 2023 letter to Harvard's president demanding immediate condemnation of pro-Palestinian student speech, framing the issue as antisemitism. In November 2024 he voted against three Senate resolutions that would have blocked arms and munitions sales to Israel, calling the effort 'dangerous anti-Semitism,' and in February 2025 he introduced the United States-Israel Defense Partnership Act to expand counter-drone and anti-tunneling cooperation with Israel. Together these actions show active legislative shielding of Israel's military and suppression of Palestinian advocacy.
